<thought>Based on the notes, subnetwork 1 consists of two resistors where one value is twice the other. The measured total resistance between terminals A and X1 is 6.667 Ω. For two series resistors R and 2R, the equivalent resistance is 3R = 6.667 Ω, giving R ≈ 2.222 Ω and 2R ≈ 4.444 Ω. The simplest topology that matches this description is a series connection: A – R1 – intermediate node – R2 – X1.</thought>
